independentQA.checks: Independent CP949 CSV parsing, buy-minus-sell validation, individual evidence comparison, constituent values and volume, and theme sums
caveats: CSV content itself has no date or investor metadata; filenames and supplied capture provenance establish those selections. Individual evidence explicitly records 20261104 start/end. No new live KRX re-query performed.
78 individual records cover 18 foreign and 78 institution CSV omissions; missing values were verified in explicit investor rows, not inferred from absence.
13 theme baskets overlap; theme sums cannot be added as a deduplicated market total. Membership is the fixed 2026-10-19 basket.

captureProvenance.verification: 조회 당시 공식 화면 DOM 및 접근성 화면에서 선택조건 확인 후 각 CSV 다운로드. CSV 자체에는 날짜/투자자 열이 없으므로 조회조건은 이 화면 관측 기록에 근거합니다. 개별 누락종목 원문에는 조회기간을 별도로 보존했습니다.
captureProvenance.limitation: 당시 조회조건의 직접 관측을 바탕으로 수집자가 확인한 기록입니다. 당시 스크린샷 또는 원본 DOM/AX 별도 파일은 보존하지 않았으며 재촬영한 증거가 아닙니다.

collectorAttestation.collectionMethod: Selected query controls in authenticated official KRX page, clicked 조회, observed results, opened 다운로드 팝업, clicked CSV, received browser download. Repeated after switching investor selector.

supportingEvidence.observation: All 78 records retain displayed stock selection, start/end date and full investor table. All 78 foreign amount values agree with the bulk foreign CSV or its directly verified zero omissions. Institution CSV missing 78 members were each directly shown as 기관합계 0원.

limitations: This record is a collector attestation written after collection, not an archived screenshot or verbatim raw AX transcript.
Raw CSV exports contain no date or investor metadata. Query date and investor labels were directly observed at collection time and are attested here.
The original tab is no longer available in current browser inventory, so no retrospective screenshot was captured.
Original download filesystem modification times are supporting file provenance, not independent proof of query parameters.
